scripts.build: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run prepare-node-sdk && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.build:secure: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run prepare-node-sdk && tsc -b && vite build --minify esbuild
scripts.build:analyze: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run prepare-node-sdk && tsc -b && vite build && echo '📊 Bundle analysis available at: dist/stats.html'
scripts.build:size: du -sh dist && echo '' && echo 'JavaScript chunks:' && ls -lh dist/assets/*.js | awk '{print $5, $9}' | sort -hr
scripts.preview:build: npm run build && npm run preview
scripts.build:mac: source ./scripts/load-signing-env.sh && npm run build:secure && cargo tauri build && ./scripts/optimize-bundle.sh
scripts.build:mac:intel: source ./scripts/load-signing-env.sh && npm run build:secure && cargo tauri build --target x86_64-apple-darwin && ./scripts/optimize-bundle.sh
scripts.build:mac:universal: source ./scripts/load-signing-env.sh && npm run build:secure && cargo tauri build --target universal-apple-darwin && ./scripts/optimize-bundle.sh
scripts.build:mac:release: source ./scripts/load-signing-env.sh && npm run build:secure && cargo tauri build --bundles app && ./scripts/sign-and-notarize.sh
scripts.build:mac:release:universal: source ./scripts/load-signing-env.sh && npm run build:secure && cargo tauri build --target universal-apple-darwin --bundles app && ./scripts/sign-and-notarize.sh
scripts.release:create-branch: git checkout -b production && git push -u origin production && git checkout main && echo '✅ Production branch created!'
scripts.release:prepare: git checkout production && git merge main && echo '✅ Ready to release! Run: npm run release:publish'
scripts.release:publish: git push origin production && echo '🚀 Release triggered! Check GitHub Actions for progress.'
scripts.health:baseline: knip --reporter json 2>/dev/null > .knip-baseline.json && echo '✅ Baseline saved to .knip-baseline.json'
scripts.testinstall:dev: cross-env VITE_TEST_MODE=true VITE_TEST_PREREQUISITES=true npm run dev:mac
scripts.test:clean: rm -f ~/Library/Application\ Support/com.quack.terminal/*-TEST.json && echo '✅ Test data cleaned!'
scripts.test:reset: npm run test:clean && echo '🧪 Starting Quack in TEST MODE...' && npm run test:dev
